messages:
maya: Quick sync — we have a small hotfix for token counting that should go out today. Need agreement on how we tag it and whether to pin dependencies in the release commit.

maya: my proposal: bump patch only (x.y.(z+1)), no buildmeta, tag on main as "v1.4.3" and cherry-pick to stable branch. release notes: 1-sentence + link to PR.

tom: +1 on simple patch tag. prefer not to use buildmeta in tags — makes lookups awkward in some of our tooling.

sophie: curious about pinning deps — the fix touches a vendored mini-lib. Should we pin the lib version in the release commit or rely on CI reproducibility?

ryan: pin it. We've had one rollback in prod because transitive changed. For patches we should pin transitive ranges to exact sha in the lockfile and include the lockfile diff in the PR.

maya: agreed on lockfile pin. keep tag simple. also, for release notes: include the changelog line + indicate whether config migration required (no here).

tom: question on tagging convention: do we tag with the commit hash suffix like "v1.4.3+g123abcd"? I've seen that help traceability but bot scripts choke sometimes.

sophie: I vote no on buildmeta. Our deploy bot expects tags of the form "vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH" for automatic promotion. Adding +meta breaks the regex.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: tag v1.4.3 detected on main by maya. Canary rollout started (10% traffic). Notifying oncall.

ryan: if deploy-bot is already reading plain tags, we should keep that invariant. For internal traceability we can put the build meta in the release notes or CI artifact metadata.

maya: +1. operational invariant > extra noise in tag. keep tags strict, put build info in the release body.

tom: rollback policy question — if canary shows elevated 5xx we rollback by removing traffic routing and create a v1.4.3-rollback tag? or just pin previous tag?

sophie: we avoid creating rollback tags. Just promote previous stable tag (v1.4.2) back to 100%. Create a rollback entry in release notes and open a postmortem issue.

ryan: also, add a short checklist in the PR description: changelog line, lockfile diff, test matrix snippet, update release notes template. Then releases team can cut patch with one click.

maya: i'll update the PR template. Example tag command in the docs section:
```
# on main
git tag -a v1.4.3 -m "patch: fix token counting"
git push origin v1.4.3
```

maya: and example release notes snippet: "fix: correct token counting for streaming responses (cherry-picked from abc123). No config changes." with link to CI artifact.

tom: small nit — should we enforce "patch:" prefix in changelog lines? that'd help automation classify release notes.

sophie: yes, automated parsing uses that prefix already. enforce in PR checklist.

deploy-bot: Canary results: latency/req within baseline, error rate at +0.1% — continuing rollout to 50% in 10m.

maya: rolling to 50%. thanks everyone. I'll push docs updates and add the pinned lockfile.

ryan: one more: add a line to the release README about change windows for Dedicated customers — patches allow the usual weekly window, but any config changes still need the 48h notice.

maya: noted — will add. closing thread once v1.4.3 hits 100%. :shipit:
